Mercurius Cyberchair.name: Mercurius Cyberchair
Mercurius Cyberchair.description:
An impressively affordable cyberchair. While using it the operator's base MOVE becomes 5, with all regular movement options remaining available.

Operation of the cyberchair requires either a free hand, or interface plugs.

If the operator suffers a critical injury that reduces their MOVE, the MOVE of the cyberchair is instead effected.

The cyberchair cannot be targeted specifically, nor can it be disabled via EMP effects.

Spider Cyberchair.name: Spider Cyberchair
Spider Cyberchair.description:
An impressively affordable cyberchair. While using it the operator's base MOVE becomes 5, with all regular movement options remaining available.

Additionally, this cyberchair has room for 4 cyberlimp options. Any options installed always count as being paired.

Operation of the cyberchair requires either a free hand, or interface plugs.

If the operator suffers a critical injury that reduces their MOVE, the MOVE of the cyberchair is instead effected.

The cyberchair cannot be targeted specifically, nor can it be disabled via EMP effects.
